layout.folderRule: Male/Female from the wardrobe category; the outfit folder is the exact outfit id

parameters.rig: soft-human selected FBX base: 15 source bones rebased with a Hips root — 16 joints, source skin weights, baked palette regions
parameters.skinning: The bake stores the source four-influence weights; every exported vertex sums to 1 and keeps its source joints
parameters.geometry: One skinned mesh per recipe rebuilt from the active bake bind pool; the exact baked full index table is used
parameters.animation: The bake stores GPU skinning matrices for 8 height fits, 3 hand modes, 15 activities and 3 walks; this export inverts them to local joint tracks and grounds the standing/walk clips exactly as the atlas does

variants.child: runtime age variant of the same recipe id (approved 65% height / 70% width fit); the SoftHumanChild review prefab is the sample
variants.low: runtime detail variant of the same recipe id (shared baked vertex pool, <10% triangles); the retained low-detail GLB is soft-human-adult-commuter-daypack-low.glb

parameters.provenance: Derived from the active soft-human bake. The base is a game extract without a redistribution licence; clothing, accessories and motion adapters are locally authored.
